_evidence: 0x0053fdcc (one caller 0x53fc08) reads the performance counter through 0x54e733 (QueryPerformanceCounter; the oracle's stub gives now = 2^32 + rand(2^40) + 1..50000 per case, so now_hi is 1..256 (257 only on a carry) and now_lo random), stores it at 0x830004/08, then walks k = 0..21: 'mov edx,[ebx]; or edx,edx; je skip; cmp edx,[0xb1bb40]; je skip' (ebx = 0xb1b8d8 + 0x1c*k: slot id dword, 0 = free; [0xb1bb40] = 0xb1b8d8 + 22*0x1c is the current id) and 'sub eax,[esi]; sbb edx,[esi+4]' (esi = 0x83002b + 8*k, an unaligned qword stamp); it RETURNS ebx at the first slot with now - stamp > 0x4446390 (hi > 0 signed via jg, or hi == 0 and lo above via jbe), else 0 after 22 slots (0x53fe2c). Only fixed-address dwords are read, nothing is dereferenced: every value is valid. Domain: ids a table filled up to n slots (prefix n in {0,1,3,10,22}; ids from {1,2,3,3,3}) so both 'je skip' tests go both ways and the all-skipped return 0 occurs; current id from {0,1,2,3}. Stamp lows full-range. Stamp highs: one range PER SLOT, descending with k (slot k: 246-12k .. 257-12k, clamped at 0; slot 21: 0..5 includes 0 = never stamped): because the walk stops at the first stale slot, independent stamps around now_hi stop it after ~2 slots and the hi == 0 case (stamp_hi == now_hi with no borrow, or now_hi-1 with a borrow - one high value per case out of 256) is hit ~1-2 times per 200 cases; descending stamps make the walk skip future stamps (hi negative: jg not taken, jne taken) until the slot whose stamp straddles now_hi, so hi == 0 (0x53fe16) is reached ~9 times per 200 cases, besides stale returns (jg taken) and all-future walks. Not reachable with this counter model: 'jbe 0x53fe21' TAKEN at 0x53fe1b (hi == 0 and now_lo - stamp_lo <= 0x4446390, a slot stamped < 20 s before the seeded counter) needs a stamp correlated with the stub's per-case counter value, which no fixed-address layout can supply (~1.6% of the hi == 0 hits).
